lifecycleTaxonomy.definition: The migration, seed script, or ingestion script exists in the repository with complete DDL/DML.
The artifact passes local syntax, DDL parsing, schema linters, and mock-execution/unit test suites.
The exact source identity sets, schemas, and non-destructive upserts have been reconciled against authoritative specifications.
Formal CTO authorization has been granted for execution in a specified environment (e.g. via explicit directive).
The artifact has actually been executed against the specified database environment (staging or production).
Execution has been confirmed by independent inspection of the target database catalog (pg_catalog / tables).
The resulting database state has been formally accepted by the authorized independent CTO adjudicator under Rule IV-001.
